about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Ascension of the Lord” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grant us, we beseech You, almighty and merciful God, that we may obtain the unseen fruit of what we have received to partake of in visible mysteries. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: we have received to partake of
we may obtain through unseen efficacy

ex.w016: The prayer contrasts reception in visible mysteries with the unseen effect sought here. What has been received remains what we ask to attain. Here “efficacy” means that unseen working.
